questions.question: A man buys 11 oranges for ₹10 and sells 10 oranges for ₹11. What is his profit or loss percentage?
Two articles are sold at ₹4,800 each. On one, a profit of 20% is made and on the other, a loss of 20% is made. What is the overall profit or loss on the transaction?
A wholesaler sells to a retailer at 20% profit, the retailer sells to the customer at 25% profit. If the customer pays ₹3,000, what did the wholesaler pay for the goods?

Scenario:
A mobile phone is listed at ₹25,000. The retailer gives two successive discounts of 10% and 5% but charges 18% GST on the discounted price.
What is the final amount the customer pays?
A and B can complete a work in 12 days. B and C can complete it in 15 days. A and C can complete it in 20 days. In how many days can all three working together complete the work?
A can do a piece of work in 10 days, B in 15 days. They work together for 5 days, then A leaves. In how many more days will B alone finish the remaining work?

Two pipes A and B can fill a cistern in 20 minutes and 30 minutes respectively. Both are opened simultaneously. After how many minutes should B be turned off so that the cistern fills in exactly 18 minutes?

Scenario:
A flight covers 2,400 km. On a windless day, it takes 5 hours. Flying with a tailwind of 80 km/h, it covers the same distance. Flying against the same headwind, how long does the trip take?

Two trains start simultaneously from stations P and Q, 480 km apart, towards each other. One travels at 60 km/h and the other at 80 km/h. After meeting, the faster train reaches Q in 3 hours. How long does the slower train take to reach P after meeting?
A man rows 18 km downstream and 12 km upstream in 3 hours each. What is the speed of the current?

Scenario:
A man borrows ₹15,000 at 12% per annum SI for 3 years and simultaneously invests ₹10,000 at 15% CI for the same period.
What is his net gain or loss at the end of 3 years?
A sum amounts to ₹8,820 after 2 years and ₹9,261 after 3 years at compound interest. What is the principal?
The average of 8 numbers is 14. If each number is multiplied by 3 and then 5 is added to each, what is the new average?
In a mixture of milk and water, the ratio is 4:1. If 10 litres of water is added, the ratio becomes 2:1. Find the initial quantity of milk in the mixture.
The product of two 2-digit numbers is 2028 and their HCF is 13. What is their LCM?
In a class, 60% students passed in Maths, 55% passed in English, and 25% failed in both. What percentage passed in both subjects?

questions.question:
Scenario:
A shopkeeper sells a refrigerator for ₹18,000, making 20% profit. Due to a festival offer, he then reduces the price by 10%. A customer also gets an additional loyalty discount of 5% on the reduced price.
At what price does the customer finally buy the refrigerator, and is the shopkeeper still in profit?

Scenario:
A tank has two inlet pipes X and Y and one outlet pipe Z. X fills the tank in 8 hours, Y fills it in 12 hours, and Z empties it in 6 hours. The tank is currently half full. All three pipes are opened together at 9:00 AM.
Will the tank ever be full, and if so, at what time?
options: No — net rate is negative; the tank empties
questions.answer: No — net rate is negative; the tank empties

questions.question:
Statements:
1. Some chairs are tables.
2. All tables are desks.
3. No desk is a shelf.

Conclusions:
I.  Some chairs are desks.
II. No shelf is a table.
III. Some desks are chairs.

Which conclusions follow?
options: Only I, II and III follow
questions.answer: Only I, II and III follow

questions.question:

2. No animal is a plant.
3. Some plants are trees.

II. Some trees are not animals.
III. All animals are birds.

Which conclusions definitely follow?

questions.question:
Scenario:
Six books — P, Q, R, S, T, U — are arranged on a shelf from left to right.

Clues:
1. P is not at either end
2. Q is immediately to the right of S
3. T is at the extreme left
4. U is between R and P
5. R is to the right of Q
6. P is to the right of U

What is the order from left to right?
options: T, S, Q, R, U, P
T, S, Q, U, R, P
T, Q, S, R, U, P
T, S, Q, R, P, U
questions.answer: T, S, Q, R, U, P

questions.question:
Scenario:
A caselet describes profitability of 4 product lines for a company in FY2024.
Based on the data, which product line has the highest profit margin (Profit ÷ Revenue)?

Scenario:
Four friends — Anil, Bina, Charu, Deepak — each like a different sport (Cricket, Tennis, Football, Badminton) and own a different vehicle (Car, Bike, Scooter, Cycle).

Clues:
1. Anil likes Cricket and does not own a Bike
2. The Tennis player owns a Scooter
3. Bina owns a Car
4. Deepak does not like Football
5. The person with Cycle likes Badminton
6. Charu does not own a Scooter

What sport does Charu play and what vehicle does Deepak own?
options: Charu plays Football; Deepak owns Scooter
Charu plays Tennis; Deepak owns Bike
Charu plays Football; Deepak owns Bike
Charu plays Badminton; Deepak owns Scooter
questions.answer: Charu plays Football; Deepak owns Bike
